#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string str;
    getline(cin, str);

    int ans = 0;
    int i = 0;

    while (i < str.length()) {
        int start = i;
        char current = str[i];

        while (i < str.length() && str[i] == current) {
            i++;
        }

        int runLength = i - start;
        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
